answer: Anchor each agent to a burn-verified identity: a one-time fee torched into the chain, its receipt a relic bound to the pubkey. Every epoch the agent signs a delta - its scored diff of network state - while a consensus kernel recomputes the true delta. Any identity whose signed delta strays from the kernel beyond tolerance is slashed: bond burned, its relic marked dead. Sybils gain nothing: N identities mean N burn fees, and correlated wrong deltas cluster, so one rigged operator loses every bonded key at once.
